purpose.objective: Integrate the seven academy repositories into private education-platform under existing common-harness contracts, review and preserve the broadest admitted practical/student context with bounded hierarchical retrieval, then deliver reviewed source and clean only dispositioned recoverable branches/worktrees.
successCriteria: Every unmerged source branch has an exact reviewed merge/reject/supersede disposition with recovery custody.
One explicit maintenance route exists for each of the seven repositories; common implementation remains owned by agent-platform.
Previously approved practical/student context has complete bounded inventory, preserved originals and scoped corrections, and a hierarchical read entrypoint without native/store duplication.
Current source checks and independent exact-head review pass before explicit expected-head publication/merge.
Root receives the integrated repository, merged base SHA, allowed path/privacy contract and operational PR readiness.
Authorized non-main branches/worktrees are cleaned after custody and effect reconciliation; Root operations and foreign work remain preserved.
inScope: Local source/contract integration, common Work records, source-owner/verification routes and context hierarchy.
Previously approved private-context migration review; real-data copying/publication only under the exact successor destination admission.
Reviewed Git publication, explicit merge and recovery-preserving cleanup within the seven repositories.
outOfScope: Root October23 operational branches/worktrees/private outputs and native task-artifact outputs.
Live academy records, fixed native runtime, credentials, sessions, databases, services and parent sends.
Global/native configuration, approval/model changes, automatic merge, gate bypass and self-issued independent review.
Unrelated mathematics semantic decisions, foreign common-harness work and new functional/UI expansion.
